title: Export job slows the database (chain)
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the database as the faulty component, labels the issue as a query timeout/slow query, and points to the newly added sales‑export job as the trigger.
root_cause: The newly added sales-export scheduled job runs a heavy aggregation query that exceeds PostgreSQL's statement_timeout, causing API timeouts and 502 errors.
truth: The new sales-export job was meant to run daily but runs every 5 minutes. Its huge export query keeps PostgreSQL busy, so the api's queries time out, its workers are killed, and nginx answers 502. web and api only show the effect.
